==Description==
The '''Brute''' was an [[Enemies|enemy]] that appeared in [[The Heights]] as part of the [[SFOTH Event]]. It had the same walkspeed as the [[Stone Viking]], but had less health than the [[Crystalite]]. It was able to stun towers through its ''Rock Throw'' ability.

The '''Brute''' could also be spawned by the [[Swordmaster]].

==Appearance==
The '''Brute''' was slightly more broad than the [[Slow]], while being smaller than the [[Slow Boss]]. It had muscular arms, grey skin, walked with a hunchback and had its head slightly tilted. It also had blue glowing eyes. It wore grey shorts, had straps around its body and wore a gladiator helmet.

==Strategy==
*The '''Brute''' is weaker than the [[Crystalite]], meaning that, in terms of health, the '''Brute''' is generally easier to kill.
**However, the '''Brute''' is capable of stunning towers with its ''Rock Throw'' ability, making them pose a huge threat if underestimated.
*If you have any cheap towers, such as the [[Scout]], they can be used to distract the '''Brute''', while long-range towers, such as the [[Ranger|Outlaw]], can be used to kill the '''Brute''' from a distance away.
**Alternatively, you can place your towers away from the path so that the rocks thrown by the '''Brute''' are less likely to hit them, as the '''Brute's''' ''Rock Throw'' ability has limited range.

==Trivia==
*The design of the '''Brute''' was very similar to R2D's [[w:c:r2d:Tank|Tank]] which in turn was inspired by [[w:c:left4dead:The Tank|the Tank]] in ''Left 4 Dead''.
**The name '''Brute''' was likely based on R2DA's [[w:c:r2da:Brute|Brute]].
**The '''Brute''' was also similar in design to the [[Tank|Tank 1]] and [[Tank 2]].
*The arms of the '''Brute''' were taken from the [https://www.roblox.com/bundles/299/Superhero Superhero] bundle from the Roblox catalog.
*The '''Brute's''' helmet is a re-textured version of the {{RLinkC|13844730|Spiked Helm of Shining Righteous Truth}} accessory from the Roblox catalog.
